verdict.rationale: Most operational surfaces of Agentic Commerce are API-driven. Catalog publishing goes through the v2 Product Catalog Import API with webhooks, orders arrive via checkout.session.completed and List CheckoutSessions, and agent details are exposed as an API field. SPTs, machine payments and Link CLI spend requests are all programmatic, and the MCP server exposes the Stripe API to agents. However, seller onboarding and per-agent consent are described as Dashboard self-serve flows, MCP write actions such as refunds require approval through a human-clicked URL, and there is no explicit UI/API parity statement. missing for 10: documented API equivalents for ACS seller onboarding and agent-approval steps, an explicit parity commitment, a discoverable OpenAPI spec (the probed paths returned 404), independent hands-on confirmation.
